name: Distance Map Acceleration
aliases: Accelerated Volume Rendering with Chebyshev Distance Maps
Empty space skipping using distance maps
Ray Traversal with Distance Map Skipping
definition: Ray casting volume renderer that uses precomputed gradient maps, occupancy maps, and distance maps for efficient empty space skipping.
summary: Distance Map Acceleration is a ray traversal technique that uses a precomputed Chebyshev distance map to skip empty regions, enabling larger leap steps than binary occupancy grids.
